title: contract review against a playbook: before and after

before.label: today: manual
before.total: ≈ 93 min of legal time per contract (blended)

steps.task: Log the request in the CLM, pull the deal context, identify the paper type and counterparty
Read the whole contract, including definitions, schedules and cross-references
Compare each clause with the playbook and note every deviation and missing clause
Draft redlines and comments, copying fallback wording from precedent agreements
Check the DPA against Article 28 and the security schedule against policy
Write a risk note for the deal owner and request approval for off-playbook positions
Approve or reject escalated positions on liability, indemnity and data protection
Send the redline, track versions and update the CLM record

after.label: agent workflow
after.total: ≈ 27 min of legal time per contract (blended)

steps.task: Convert the file, split it into numbered clauses, attach definitions and cross-references
Label each clause against the clause taxonomy, with a confidence score
Compare each clause with the standard and fallback positions; quote every deviation
Flag missing required clauses, verify quotes word for word, apply the approval matrix
Draft standard redlines from approved fallback wording in the clause library
Draft non-standard redlines: limitation of liability, indemnity, data protection
Write the risk note for the lawyer and the deal owner, with approvals needed
Sign off every redline before it leaves; full review of MSAs and off-playbook asks
Write tracked changes, clause metadata, approvals and the reviewer to the CLM
